sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bc(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c','Y') and n['pixels']>10:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return d
print("before:", bc(current_frame))
r=action(['DOWN','DOWN','DOWN'], intent='explore')
print("after DOWN x3:", bc(current_frame))
print("res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
